jobs.title: BPSC AEDO 2026: 935 Assistant Education Development Officer Posts
jobs.summary: Bihar Public Service Commission (Advt No. 16/2026) has notified 935 Assistant Education Development Officer posts in the Education Department, Government of Bihar, replacing Advt No. 87/2025. Any graduate can apply online from 1 to 31 December 2026.
lines: Eligibility: Bachelor's degree (any stream) or equivalent from a recognised university
Age: minimum 21 years as on 01-08-2026; maximum as on 01-08-2025: UR male 37, UR female/BC/EBC 40, SC/ST 42
Pay: Pay Level 5, basic pay Rs 29,200 plus allowances
Fee: Rs 100 (Rs 200 extra biometric fee if Aadhaar is not given)
Selection: Prelims (GS, 150 marks, screening), Mains (General Language qualifying, General Studies 100, General Aptitude 100), document verification; no interview
Dates: apply online 1–31 Dec 2026; fee payment till 30 Dec 2026

jobs.title: BPSC Assistant Director (Agriculture) 2026: 147 Posts
jobs.summary: Bihar Public Service Commission (Advt Nos. 17/2026 to 21/2026) has notified 147 Assistant Director / Assistant Controller posts at Pay Level 9 in the Bihar Agriculture Department: Agricultural Engineering 50, Statistics 36, Weights & Measures 26, Chemistry 21 and Plant Protection 14. Apply online from 15 December 2026 to 12 January 2027.
lines: Eligibility: post-wise bachelor's degree: Agricultural Engineering; Statistics/Mathematics or Agri Statistics; B.Sc (with Physics)/Engineering/Technology (Weights & Measures); Agriculture Science or Science with Chemistry; Agriculture with Plant Protection elective
Age: 21 to 37 years (UR male) as on 01-08-2026; UR female/BC/EBC 40, SC/ST 42; PwD +10
Pay: Pay Level 9
Fee: Rs 100 (Rs 200 extra biometric fee if Aadhaar is not given)
Selection: written exam (General Hindi qualifying, GK 100, two subject papers of 200 each) and 50-mark interview; up to 25 marks weightage for Bihar contract service on the same post
Dates: apply online 15 Dec 2026 – 12 Jan 2027; fee payment till 11 Jan 2027

jobs.title: GSSSB Laboratory Technician Class-3 2026: 227 Posts
jobs.summary: Gujarat Subordinate Service Selection Board (Advt No. 472/202627) has announced 227 Laboratory Technician (Class-3) posts in Public Health (169), Medical Services (36) and ESI Scheme (22) offices. B.Sc graduates with a lab technician diploma can apply online from 1 to 15 December 2026.
lines: Eligibility: Bachelor's degree in Chemistry/Microbiology/Bio-chemistry/Bio-technology plus Diploma in Laboratory Technician or Medical Laboratory Technician; basic computer knowledge; Gujarati or Hindi
Age: 18 to 36 years as on 15-12-2026 (relaxation as per notification)
Pay: Rs 40,800/month fixed pay for 5 years, then Level 5 (Rs 29,200–92,300)
Fee: Unreserved Rs 500
Selection: single MCQ exam (CBRT/OMR) with Part A and Part B, document verification
Dates: apply online 1–15 Dec 2026

jobs.title: BEL Panchkula Trainee Engineer 2026: 49 Posts
jobs.summary: Bharat Electronics Limited, Panchkula Unit (Advt No. 2026-27/11/PK/TE/006) is engaging 49 Trainee Engineers (Electronics 28, Mechanical 20, Electrical 1) on a fixed-tenure basis for B.E./B.Tech graduates. Apply online by 10 December 2026.
lines: Eligibility: 4-year B.E./B.Tech/B.Sc Engineering in the relevant discipline with pass class; no experience needed
Age: up to 28 years (General/EWS) as on 01-11-2026; OBC +3, SC/ST +5, PwBD +10
Pay: Rs 40,000 / 45,000 / 50,000 per month (1st/2nd/3rd year), consolidated
Fee: Rs 150 + GST; SC/ST/PwBD/ex-servicemen exempt
Dates: last date 10 Dec 2026

jobs.title: DRDO LRDE Bengaluru Apprentice 2026: 105 Seats (Walk-in)
jobs.summary: DRDO's Electronics and Radar Development Establishment (LRDE), Bengaluru (Advt No. LRDE/APP-TRG/2026-27/W-1) is engaging 105 apprentices: Graduate Engineering 43, Graduate General 26, Technician Diploma 16 and ITI Trade 20, through walk-in selection on 15 and 16 December 2026.
lines: Eligibility: B.E./B.Tech, general degree, engineering diploma or ITI in relevant discipline, passed in 2024 or later; NATS/NAPS registration required
Age: minimum 18 years as on 01-12-2026
Stipend: Rs 9,600 to Rs 12,300 per month by qualification
Selection: academic merit / written test / interview as required
Dates: walk-in 15 Dec 2026 (graduate engineering, diploma) and 16 Dec 2026 (graduate general, ITI), report before 10 AM
